query: INSERT INTO core.event (event_pk, aggregate_sequence_number, event_type, schema_version, aggregate_pk_ref, aggregate_type, occurred_at, actor_pk_ref, actor_type, prior_value, new_value, reason_code_fk, source, correlation_pk_ref, correlation_type, metadata, prior_event_hash, event_hash) VALUES ($1,
UPDATE ar.account_balance_bucket SET balance_minor_units = $1 WHERE account_balance_bucket_pk = $2

SELECT b.account_balance_bucket_pk, b.account_fk, d.code, d.waterfall_priority, b.balance_minor_units FROM ar.account_balance_bucket b JOIN ar.balance_bucket_definition d ON d.balance_bucket_definition_pk = b.balance_bucket_definition_fk WHERE b.account_fk = ANY($1)

UPDATE ar.account_summary_read_model SET balance_buckets = balance_buckets || $1::jsonb, balance_minor_units = (SELECT COALESCE(sum(value::bigint), $5) FROM jsonb_each_text(balance_buckets || $2::jsonb)), last_global_sequence_number = $3 WHERE account_summary_read_model_pk = $4
UPDATE ar.account SET aggregate_sequence_number = $1, status = $2, is_disputed = $3, interest_accrued_through = $4, queue_code = $5::text WHERE account_pk = $6

SELECT account_pk, aggregate_sequence_number, client_account_number, debt_type, contract_type, currency_code, status, is_disputed, list_date, itemization_date, interest_accrued_through, queue_code FROM ar.account WHERE account_pk = ANY($1) ORDER BY account_pk FOR UPDATE

SELECT k.id, e.aggregate_sequence_number, e.event_hash FROM unnest($1::uuid[]) AS k(id) CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT aggregate_sequence_number, event_hash FROM core.event WHERE aggregate_pk_ref = k.id ORDER BY aggregate_sequence_number DESC LIMIT $2) e
DISCARD ALL

SELECT event_pk, global_sequence_number, aggregate_sequence_number, event_type, schema_version, aggregate_pk_ref, aggregate_type, occurred_at, recorded_at, actor_pk_ref, actor_type, prior_value, new_value, reason_code_fk, source, correlation_pk_ref, correlation_type, metadata, prior_event_hash, even

SELECT event_pk, global_sequence_number, aggregate_sequence_number, event_type, schema_version, aggregate_pk_ref, aggregate_type, occurred_at, recorded_at, actor_pk_ref, actor_type, prior_value, new_value, reason_code_fk, source, correlation_pk_ref, correlation_type, metadata, prior_event_hash, even
UPDATE core.projection_checkpoint SET last_global_sequence_number = $2, updated_at = now() WHERE projection_name = $1
BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED
SELECT account_pk FROM ar.account WHERE account_pk BETWEEN $1 AND $2 ORDER BY account_pk
SELECT last_global_sequence_number FROM core.projection_checkpoint WHERE projection_name = $1
SELECT last_global_sequence_number FROM core.projection_checkpoint WHERE projection_name = $1 AND failed_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT last_global_sequence_number, definition_digest, failed_at IS NOT NULL, failure_kind, failed_global_sequence_number FROM core.projection_checkpoint WHERE projection_name = $1
SELECT CASE WHEN is_called THEN last_value ELSE $1 END, pg_postmaster_start_time()::text || $2 || current_database() FROM core.event_global_sequence_seq
COMMIT

INSERT INTO core.batch_job_chunk (batch_job_run_fk, chunk_sequence_number, range_start, range_end, status) SELECT $1, chunk, (array_agg(key ORDER BY key))[$3], (array_agg(key ORDER BY key DESC))[$4], $5 FROM (SELECT account_pk AS key, (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY account_pk) - $6) / $2 AS chunk FROM
SELECT CASE WHEN is_called THEN last_value ELSE $1 END FROM core.event_global_sequence_seq
SELECT pg_current_xact_id()::text::bigint
SELECT pg_snapshot_xmin(pg_current_snapshot())::text::bigint

UPDATE core.batch_job_chunk SET status = $3, claimed_by_instance = $2, claim_expires_at = now() + interval $4 WHERE batch_job_chunk_pk = (SELECT batch_job_chunk_pk FROM core.batch_job_chunk WHERE batch_job_run_fk = $1 AND status = $5 ORDER BY chunk_sequence_number LIMIT $6 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RE
UPDATE core.batch_job_chunk SET status = $2, completed_at = now(), error_detail = $3 WHERE batch_job_chunk_pk = $1
SELECT pending_event_pk FROM core.pending_event WHERE status = $1 AND due_at <= now() ORDER BY due_at LIMIT $2
